versions.content: Request and Request2 messages shall only be forwarded if the destination address of the message is the global address (0xFF) or a destination address that does not correspond to any J1939NmNodePreferredAddress referenced by a J1939RmNode that references t he J1939RmChannel on which the message was received.

Request and Request2 PGs shall only be forwarded if the destination address of the PG is the global address (0xFF) or a destination address that does not correspond to any J1939NmNodePreferredAddress refer- enced by a J1939RmNode that references the J1939RmChannel on which the PG was received.
